title: Matheseos Libri VIII, Vol. 1 (Latin)
author: Julius Firmicus Maternus
description: The first volume of Firmicus Maternus's Latin astrological treatise. It provides access to the concepts and interpretive methods of late Roman astrology within a work influential in its later transmission.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/matheseoslibrivi01firmuoft).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
